messages.ko: 넥스트가 벌써 2주년이라니 정말 첫 만남부터 우리 공개될때 두근두근 기다리던 기억 다 너무 생생한데 2년차 넥스트라니! 처음 들어올땐 몇년뒤엔 내가 뭘하고있을지 어떻게 하고있을지 진짜 궁금했는데 그때 써둔 일기에 답을할수 있어서 너무 좋아 2년동안 정말정말 많은 일들이 있었고 많은 추억들이 있어서 앞으로가 더 기대되고 지금 이렇게 과분한 사랑과 성장이 있었다 라고 답해주면 2년전 하연이가 진짜 좋아할것같아 앞으로도 열심히 할거야 지금처럼 나 믿어줘~
messages.en: It's already NXT's 2nd anniversary. From the moment we first met until the day we were revealed, I still vividly remember how excited and nervous I was while waiting. I can't believe we're already in NXT's second year! When I first joined, I was so curious about what I'd be doing and what kind of person I'd become a few years later. I'm so happy that I can finally answer the diary entry I wrote back then. So many things happened over these two years, and we made so many precious memories, so I'm even more excited for what's ahead. If I could tell Hayeon from two years ago that I would receive this much love and grow this much, I think she'd be so happy. I'll keep working hard from now on too, so trust me just like you always have~
There are really so many things I want to say, but...
I believe they've already reached **Y/n**'s heart.
What did you do today?
Christmas is almost here now.
I was thinking about buying a cake with Kim Chaewon...
but we were way too full, so we gave up.
I went on a date with Chaewon today.
We seriously ate a lot.
We had steak, lasagna, and gnocchi.
Then we had Dubai chewy cookies and ice cream for dessert.
Then we went to a PC bang, played games, and ordered two ramyeon and two drinks.
I taught her how to play Overwatch.
I was totally the unnie today.
Chaewon kept playing tank...
and kept trolling.
So I made her switch to healer and just follow me around.
Very confidently.
I played DPS.
Either Genji or Bastion.
Why do you hate those? ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I'm sad.
Cover your ears, kids.
Back then...
I used to play Reaper and Sombra.
Those were my mains.
But since it's been so long...
I couldn't get back into the rhythm.
Every single one of your picks is an elementary school kid pick.
That's true.
I used to play when I was younger...
so I'm only just picking it up again after a long time.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 언니가 메르시로 너만 꽂아줄게 언니 믿지
messages.en: Unnie will pocket-heal only you as Mercy. You trust me, right?
That's seriously flirting.
Overwatch rule: if you die, eat ramen.
I got disconnected while inhaling my Jin Jjambbong.
I was eating so mindlessly...
I guess I spent too long eating. ㅎ
You trust me, right?
I'll carry us.
**Y/n**'s very own Mercy?
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
How is Mercy supposed to carry!!
Why? Healers are important too.
Earlier, who was our team's healer?
Why were they AFK in the corner?
Explain yourself.
They said they were eating Jin Jjambbong.
Ah, then that's understandable.
This is basically a hidden ad for Jin Jjambbong now.
It's basically a front ad. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Jin Jjambbong, please contact me.
I can eat it very enthusiastically.

messages.ko: 촬영할때 주시는 라면 다 먹을수 있습니다
messages.en: I can finish every cup of ramen you give me during filming.
But when it comes to Jin Jjambbong...
The best way is to microwave the cup ramen before eating it.
Food expert trait: Doesn't add the flavor oil.
That's the opposite of a food expert. The oil is 50% of Jin Jjambbong's flavor.
That won't do~
But why do Dubai chewy cookies taste bad these days?
Did my taste change?
They just taste greasy now.
The ones from Cafe PO-MO are really good...ㅜㅜ
I've already tried them.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Anyway...
It rained so much today.
I didn't have an umbrella...
so I just walked in the rain.
Everything was sparkling because it's Christmas.
It was so pretty.
It felt like a scene from youth.
Chaewon probably had pink broth dripping off her. ㅋ
Mochiz together again after one year.
Our desired vibes are really different.
But after I cut my hair...
Normally when I get a haircut...
"Oh, you cut your hair? When did you do that?"
That's usually where it ends.
But this time...
everyone who saw me...
told me it really suits me.
I'm really proud.
I've never had this many people say it suits me so well.
It's the first time.
It's Christmas Eve~ Somehow my heart feels all warm and fluffy.
Oh, you're right.
It's already past midnight.
Merry Christmas Eve~
Eve~
Kwak Yeonji is seriously so funny.
"Eve~ Threeve~ Fourve~"
I thought she was joking...
but finding out she was completely serious was honestly shocking.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
The other day...
I think I got rid of all the fatigue that had built up at once.
I seriously slept like a bear without waking up.
Shion-unnie was amazed.
I woke up for a moment, ordered delivery, then went back to sleep.
I ate the food after it arrived, then went back to sleep again.
Even then, you still managed to order delivery.
Without delivery, I'm basically a corpse.
A hedgehog hibernating for winter.
I slept so deeply that all my spines fell out.
A hedgehog without spines... that's too shocking.
I'll stick them back on.
Without spines, aren't you basically just a potato?...
That's so mean!!!!
Then I'll steam you and eat you.
That's too much!!!!!
I went somewhere crowded today...
and I'm completely drained.
Merry Christmas in advance~ ❤️
Your present is me.
I miss you~
Wo xiang ni ❤️
Hehe.
How was that? Language genius!!!
Sleep well.
Haranghae ❤️❤️
